# Keep per-extension manager creation behind its permission gates

The ext-mail startup hook creates lazy account/folder managers only with accountsRead and a message manager only with messagesRead. Address-book access has its own permission gate. Message trackers are shared host state, while these managers are attached to each extension. 1027 replaces local defineLazyGetter aliases with ExtensionCommon.defineLazyGetter without changing those boundaries. Preserve that ownership and permission split when adding a manager.

Scope: Extension manager permission and ownership boundaries.
